caption: The drawing depicts a single round, brown shield-like object with an intricate carved design. The main design on the object features a symmetrical, central U-shaped motif, flanked by two leaf-shaped elements on either side. The U-shape has pointed ends with a small cross-like symbol above it. The leaf-shaped elements are filled with crosshatched lines and are bordered by triangle shapes. The outer edge of the object is decorated with repeating geometric patterns, and there is a double-lined border outlining the circular perimeter. The overall color palette is composed of various shades of brown, giving the object a wood-like appearance. The signature “Franklyn Syres” is present in the lower right corner of the drawing. The background is plain and light in color, with no additional objects depicted.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
